seo.title: Shareable AI chat page, no website needed | Steps AI
seo.description: Create a branded page for your AI agent and share the link in your bio, ads or messages. No website needed.

hero.title: No website yet? Share your agent’s page.
hero.body: Create a page with your logo, colours and AI agent. Share the link in your Instagram bio, WhatsApp status or ads, so customers can ask questions and get help.
hero.reassurance: No website needed. Your branding. Publish when you are ready.

jobs.title: What your chat page does.
jobs.intro: A simple page that works like a front desk.

items.title: Answer from your information
items.body: The same agent and knowledge as your other channels.

items.title: Show suggested questions
items.body: Add up to five suggested questions to help visitors start.

items.title: Link to what matters
items.body: Add link cards to your catalogue, booking page or socials.

items.title: Capture leads
items.body: Show a lead popup that verifies visitors by email or phone code, and get an email for each verified lead.

triggers.title: Make it yours.
triggers.intro: Preview every change before you publish.

items.title: Your logo and colours
items.body: Set primary and background colours for light and dark themes.

items.title: Your welcome message
items.body: Write the greeting and the placeholder visitors see.

items.title: Search-friendly details
items.body: Set the page title and description for search engines.

items.title: Desktop and mobile preview
items.body: Check both before you publish, and discard changes if you need to.

setup.title: Publish your page.
setup.intro: No code and no hosting to arrange.

items.title: Create the page
items.body: Open your agent’s Site settings and create a page.

items.title: Add your branding and links
items.body: Upload your logo, choose colours and add link cards.

items.title: Publish and share
items.body: Switch publishing on and share the public link.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The page shows a public link on the Steps AI domain. Custom domains are not set up from this screen today.
The lead popup shows a small “Powered by Steps AI” badge.

items.a: No. The chat page is hosted for you, so you can share it straight away.

items.q: Where can I share the link?
items.a: Anywhere you can paste a link, such as your Instagram bio, WhatsApp status, ads or emails.

items.label: Instagram chatbot
items.body: Reply to DMs and turn comments into conversations.

cta.title: See your chat page with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
